scope: offline scanner FDC candidate reference transport and state lifecycle

tests.provider: fake FDC client; isolated SQLite integration

verified_boundaries: candidate create POST sends only scan_id and scan_revision
candidate read GET sends only scan_id and scan_revision query parameters
response validation binds scan ID, revision, schema, item digest, snapshot digest and status to the request
unknown fields including nutrition values, malformed identities, invalid FDC IDs and inconsistent empty/available status are rejected
empty candidate snapshot is accepted as a valid no-candidate result
candidate request is disabled before network unless explicit frontend flag is true
expired snapshots are rejected and stale-session 401 responses do not notify the current account
scanner stores scan reference and candidate metadata without authority token
candidate response is ignored unless the exact scan reference, owner and API host remain current
new scan, scan start, clear, logout, account switch and API host change clear candidate references
stale vision 401 responses do not dispatch logout for a newer session
candidate retrieval is a background additive operation and does not modify vision detections, confidence, nutrients or recordability
not_verified: frontend candidate flag enabled against a running server
live USDA FDC Search for scanner-generated items
candidate confirmation UI and confirmation endpoint calls
fixed Detail/profile/portion flow from the mobile scanner
native camera/gallery or Tailscale authenticated end-to-end flow
source rights approval or production registry admission
